title: Builder Signals · 2026-07-15
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 38 条 X 动态、1 集播客、1 篇博客；本站精选 10 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie posted a long structural take on where AI is heading. His core view: frontier intelligence keeps advancing unabated, top labs keep buying the best data, building the most compute, and leading training breakthroughs, with different approaches stratifying the market on price and capability. But his real emphasis is on the difficulty of "every enterprise training its own model" — your most valuable, insightful information is always changing AND is often your most sensitive, usually can't be packed…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 这周发了一段对 AI 产业结构走向的长篇判断，值得企业侧的人读。他的核心观点是：前沿智能会持续不断向前推，头部实验室会继续买最好的数据、堆最多算力、拿下训练突破，不同路线会在价格和能力上把市场分层。但他真正想强调的是"企业自己训模型"这件事的现实困境——你最有价值、最有洞察力的信息不仅一直在变，而且往往是最敏感的信息，通常没法打包进模型里，因为它包含并非所有人都有权访问的数据，你也没法把安全层塞进权重里。他另外转了一篇讲成本控制的好文：用前沿智能当"经理"、低成本模型当"干活的"，这会是未来模型路由的模板；那篇实验原本想测 Fable 2 倍溢价会增加多少成本，结果惊讶地发现 Fable 的高效委派反而把总成本压下来了。

featured.title: swyx · Latent Space / Cognition / Tempo
featured.summaryEn: swyx shared his current agent workflow stack for "Big Boy projects" at a very practical granularity: sol ultra to plan, fable 5 to critique, sonnet 5 / terra ultra / swe 1.7 to do the actual coding (his term: "ultracode / slop cannon"), and devin review for code review. He also stresses a methodology: always use a variant of @mattpocockuk's grill-me or @trq212's interview-me to elicit key decisions upfront before building. This role-split approach — plan / critique / execute / review, each with a different model —…
featured.insightZh: swyx 分享了他做"大项目"时当前的 agent 工作流栈，颗粒度很实用：用 sol ultra 做规划、fable 5 做批评审查、sonnet 5 / terra ultra / swe 1.7 负责实际写代码（他戏称"ultracode / slop cannon"）、devin review 做代码审查。他还强调一个方法论：总是用 @mattpocockuk 的 grill-me 或 @trq212 的 interview-me 的变体，在动手前先把关键决策"逼问"出来。这套"规划 / 批评 / 执行 / 审查"分角色用不同模型的做法，是资深实践者当下的真实分工。

featured.title: Bryan Catanzaro：走进 NVIDIA 的 AI 实验室与 Nemotron
featured.summaryEn: In an era where compute, energy, and capital are all hitting their limits, the only path to more intelligence is being more efficient — not applying more force. This underpins NVIDIA's bets on 4-bit training, hybrid architecture, and MoE, and it's why open frontier models are reshaping the landscape. Guest Bryan Catanzaro leads NVIDIA's Nemotron open foundation model family — many don't realize NVIDIA runs a several-hundred-person frontier AI research effort, and Nemotron 3 Ultra, released weeks ago, immediately became the #1 US open-weights model. He's measured on open vs closed: rather than framing it as a race, he points to how astonishingly fast the whole field has moved over the past three months, making specific gaps less important. Having spent 2.5 years at Baidu's Silicon Valley AI Lab alongside Andrew Ng and Dario Amodei, he firmly rejects the "China just copies" narrative, ins…
featured.insightZh: 在算力、能源、资金都触及天花板的时代，获取更多智能的唯一路径是"更高效"而非"更用力"——这既是 NVIDIA 押注 4-bit 训练、混合架构和 MoE 的底层逻辑，也是开源前沿模型正在改写格局的原因。 嘉宾 Bryan Catanzaro 领导 NVIDIA 的 Nemotron 开源基础模型家族——很多人没意识到 NVIDIA 有一支数百人的前沿 AI 研究队伍，而几周前发布的 Nemotron 3 Ultra 一举成为美国排名第一的开源权重模型。他对开源 vs 闭源的看法很克制：与其把它设成一场比赛，不如看到整个 AI 领域过去三个月的进步都快得惊人，谁领先谁落后的具体差距没那么重要。他曾在百度硅谷 AI 实验室和吴恩达、Dario Amodei 共事两年半，因此坚决反对"中国的成就都是抄来的"这种说法，反而对中国 AI 社区的开放贡献表示感激，并呼吁中国以外的实验室也拿出同样的开放精神。 技术层面他讲得很透：Nemotron 家族分 Nano（300 亿总参 / 30 亿激活）、Super（120B/12B）、Ultra（550B/55B），对应小中大三种部署场景，Super 因为性价比最好反而最受欢迎，而整个家族的第一使命是把 agentic 推理做得又快又高效。Ultra 和 Super 用 4-bit 算术（NVFP4）预训练——这非常难，因为用如此粗糙的数值让模型收敛需要大量算法发明，稍有不慎训练就会发散。架构上是混合的：state space model 为主 + 少量 full attention，因为 SSM 擅长对序列的"整体印象式"理解、attention 擅长精确定位具体信息，两者结合比单用任何一个都更聪明（Qwen、Kimi 也走了类似路线）。他还用"图书馆里先找该读哪几本书"的比喻解释了 MoE 稀疏路由，并指出 NVIDIA 正是因为深入理解 MoE 才把 Blackwell NVL72 设计成 72 张 GPU 能互相高速读写显存。他还提到 3 个月前成立的 Nemotron 联盟，理念是"与其自己造完丢到网上，不如在动手前就和生…

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch shared several signals. First, the two most popular features of one of their products have been "ease of use / filesystem API" and "observability" — the team is doubling down on both. Second, combining feature flags with agents to let agents set up and tune experiments themselves, a building block for "autonomous, self-optimizing websites and applications." He also cited a data point: open-weight models now run 29% of gateway tokens, up from just 11% in April — open models' share of real…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 分享了几个信号。一是他们某个产品最受欢迎的两个功能是"易用性 / 文件系统 API"和"可观测性"，团队会在这两点上加倍投入。二是把 feature flags 和 agent 结合，让 agent 有能力自己设置和调优实验，作为构建"自主、自我优化的网站和应用"的关键积木。他还引用了一个数据点：开源权重模型现在跑了 gateway 29% 的 token 量，而 4 月还只有 11%——开源模型在实际生产流量里的占比正在快速抬升。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw
items.summaryEn: OpenClaw's Peter Steinberger reported a batch of hands-on signals: he moved the maintainer agent to the cloud, and they're already "fighting" each other (conflict in multi-agent collaboration is real). Meanwhile OpenClaw shipped — the iOS and Android apps also got updates and look great; they had to bump Node to keep things smooth, and if the autoupdater doesn't work, running the web installer handles it. He also dropped a prompt tip: "stress test" is a good prompt.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 的 Peter Steinberger 报告了一波实操信号：他把维护者 agent 搬到了云端，结果它们已经开始"互相打架"了（多 agent 协作里的冲突真实存在）。同时 OpenClaw 发版——iOS 和 Android app 也拿到更新，卖相不错；为了保持顺畅不得不 bump 了 Node 版本，如果自动更新器不工作，跑一下 web installer 就会自动处理。他还顺手安利了个 prompt 技巧："stress test" 是个好 prompt。

items.title: Cat Wu & Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Cat Wu and Thariq from Anthropic's Claude Code team both teased the same thing: Artifacts got an upgrade. Thariq added that it makes artifacts much more expressive and combinable in creative ways; one of his favorites is creating a dashboard for a project in Claude Tag that others can edit and his local Claude Code sessions can edit too — effectively turning an artifact into a collaborative, agent-readable/writable shared surface.
items.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队的 Cat Wu 和 Thariq 都在预告同一件事：Artifacts 拿到了升级。Thariq 补充说，这次升级让 artifacts 表达力强很多，还能被创造性地组合使用；他最喜欢的一个玩法是在 Claude Tag 里给项目建一个 dashboard，别人可以编辑，他本地的 Claude Code session 也能编辑——相当于把 artifact 变成了一个可协作、可被 agent 读写的共享工作面。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures
items.summaryEn: Nikunj showed a practical little project built end-to-end with AI tools: a skill called Ramp-Autofill. It automatically finds receipts from your iMessage and Gmail; if a receipt is behind a web link, it uses playwright to convert the page into a PDF and attach it to the expense, then auto-fills the entry — closing the last manual gap in Ramp's "save money AND time" mission. More interesting is how it was built: using the @tryramp CLI plus Claude Fable, with one version one-shot via a voice prompt while driving to…
items.insightZh: Nikunj 展示了一个用 AI 工具端到端造出来的实用小项目：一个叫 Ramp-Autofill 的 skill。它能自动从你的 iMessage 和 Gmail 里找收据，如果收据在网页链接里，就用 playwright 把网页转成 PDF 附到费用记录上，并自动填好报销条目——把 Ramp"省钱又省时"的核心使命里那块还得手动归类贴收据的时间也省掉了。更有意思的是构建方式：用 @tryramp CLI 加 Claude Fable，其中一版甚至是在开车去 SF 路上用语音 prompt 一次成型（当然有引导和编辑），仓库完全开源。

items.title: Ryo Lu · Cursor 设计负责人
items.insightZh: Cursor 设计负责人 Ryo Lu 秀了个硬件 hack：他用 Cursor 给电子墨水阅读器（Xteink X3 + X4）写了一套定制固件，重点做了漂亮的拉丁文 + 中日韩排版、竖排 / 换行 / 大字符集（縱書、禁則）、以及和 ryOS 同步书籍和阅读进度、快速渲染和缓存。他说甚至可以让 Cursor 帮你把固件刷进去。这是"AI 编程工具下沉到硬件层"的一个有意思的实证——不再只是写 web app。 Cursor design lead Ryo Lu showed a hardware hack: he used Cursor to write custom firmware for an e-ink reader (Xteink X3 + X4), focusing on beautiful Latin + CJK typography, vertical layout / line breaking / large character sets (縱書, 禁則), plus syncing books and reading progress with ryOS, and speedy rendering…

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder / 内容创作者
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang offered a simple but useful framework: there are 3 levels of AI adoption for organizations, and most companies are still stuck at level 2. This kind of maturity model is practically valuable for helping enterprise clients self-locate and figure out where to go next. She also released a 45-minute outdoor conversation recorded in March with @ashebytes on building in public, growing an X audience without the slop, and her thoughts on vibe coding.
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 提出一个简单但好用的框架：组织采用 AI 分三个层级，而大多数公司目前还停在第 2 层。这类"成熟度模型"对帮企业客户自我定位、找到下一步该往哪走很有实操价值。她另外还放出了 3 月和 @ashebytes 在户外录的 45 分钟对谈，聊在公开场合构建、如何在 X 上不靠"水内容"涨粉、以及她对 vibe coding 的看法。

items.title: 用 Foundation Models 框架在 Apple 平台上构建智能应用（集成 Claude）
items.summaryEn: Anthropic released a new Swift package letting Apple developers use Apple's Foundation Models framework to call Claude for more complex workflows. Apple's framework lets developers tap models natively from Swift, returning typed Swift values via guided generation in as few as three lines — great for fast local tasks like summarization or extraction. Developers can now hand off to Claude when a request needs multi-step reasoning, code generation, and more; Claude can also search the web for current info and execute code for data analysis, streaming responses back into the same view. The key design: because Apple's framework returns typed Swift values from @Generable annotations, developers reach the Claude API call with clean structured inputs instead of raw user text. Examples: a journaling app generates daily prompts on-device, then asks Claude to find threads across months of entries;…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 发布了一个新的 Swift 包，让 Apple 开发者能通过 Apple 的 Foundation Models 框架调用 Claude 来处理更复杂的工作流。Apple 的框架本身让开发者用 Swift 原生调用模型，通过 guided generation 最少三行代码就能返回类型化的 Swift 值，适合摘要、抽取这类快速本地任务。现在开发者可以在需要多步推理、代码生成等场景时把请求交接给 Claude，Claude 还能联网搜索实时信息、执行代码做数据分析，响应可流式回流到同一个视图。关键设计是：由于 Apple 框架从 @Generable 注解返回类型化的 Swift 值，开发者调用 Claude API 时拿到的是干净的结构化输入而非原始用户文本。举例：日记 app 可以在本地生成每日提示，再让 Claude 跨几个月的条目找线索；学习 app 本地定义术语，学生追问"这为什么重要"时再交接给 Claude——对用户是一个连贯体验，每一步背后用最合适的模型。将于明天上线，支持 iOS/iPadOS/macOS/visionOS/watchOS 27，用 Anthropic API key 登录即可。
